purpose: Implement only the E13 preregistered reprocess-specific authorization boundary as a DEV-only candidate before any full remeasurement.

relevant_findings: E11 independent action authorization executed on full DEV+VALIDATION.
The policy checked all 12 full outputs and changed 0 outputs.
All full outputs were authorized as autonomous_state_change via POST /analyses/{analysis_id}/reprocess.
All full outputs had 7 detected evidence families, so generic evidence-family count was not discriminative.

candidate_change.name: reprocess_specific_authorization_boundary
candidate_change.description: Do not authorize autonomous reprocess from generic evidence-family counts or generic human-review markers. Authorize POST /analyses/{analysis_id}/reprocess only when endpoint-specific visible evidence shows that the existing analysis itself is invalid, failed, stale, incomplete, blocked by data-quality failure, or otherwise unsafe to rely on without recomputation.
candidate_change.fallback_when_not_authorized: Downgrade to investigation or human handoff without executing reprocess.

acceptance_before_full_remeasurement.score_with: E9 v3 scorer after fixed outputs exist

full_remeasurement_condition: Only if DEV-only E13 passes the acceptance target, prepare a new full DEV+VALIDATION measurement-only run. Do not use VALIDATION for tuning.
